items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: When Redd Foxx left here, I thought he was through. And then the first thing I know, he's there doing things in Hollywood, up there in Los Angeles.

ctx.x: -- you mentioned and a lot of other people. When he's great, he's very foul-mouthed; they don't even keep the children go see him. But it was a different era. Nowadays, you can get away with that stuff that Alan Drew couldn't get away with. He'd probably be famous if he were around today, with all of that foul talk. Like Redd Foxx and Richard Pryor is doing.
Yeah, you know Redd Foxx. What about that?
